_note: Blind LLM query reformulations for the query-reformulation-vs-dense-lane ablation. Each entry is a single-shot rewrite of the ORIGINAL query text only (id + query fields of eval/real-vault/queries.json) -- the rewriting model did not see the 'relevant' target document(s) for any query while writing these, mirroring the original N=2 test methodology (a curator agent that must guess vocabulary without already knowing the answer). See scripts/eval-query-reformulation.mjs and docs/evaluation/query-reformulation-ablation-2026-08-05.md.
